learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback models when LLM API calls fail with HTTP 400 errors to prevent coverage gaps
Distinguish between 'inconclusive due to tool errors' and 'inconclusive due to security ambiguity' in verdict reporting
When a report has >30% file coverage gaps due to tool errors, automatically trigger a re-audit with a different model before publishing an inconclusive verdict
Track API error rates per model and route around models experiencing transient failures
